endpoints.interpretation: Batch FF removed PFAS from NF concentrate by transferring PFAS into foamate; long-chain PFAS (PFOA, PFHxS, PFOS) exhibited >94–95% removal even without co-surfactant, while addition of a cationic co-surfactant (Montaline C40) substantially improved removal of several short-chain PFAS and increased total PFAS removal by up to 17%.

limitations.statement: Batch FF tests were conducted on NF concentrate from a single groundwater source and specific NF operating conditions, which may limit extrapolation to other concentrates with different compositions or ionic strengths.

The FF experiments focus on PFAS transfer from bulk concentrate to foamate but do not report subsequent treatment, destruction, or disposal of the PFAS-rich foamate.
